presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Pays N.V. Heathorn Company $16,346 for steam pipe and tank repairs at The Center at Foster
summary: The district hires N.V. Heathorn Company to remove a stainless-steel chemical pipe from the steam header and cap it, then reconnect piping to the feed water tank with a new check valve and repaired insulation, as described in the company's July 12, 2021 proposal. The amount is $16,346.00, for work from September 23, 2021 to December 31, 2021.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Change Order No.1, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor - District and Redgwick Construction Company – Sherman Elementary School Playmatting Installation Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Change Order No. 1, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor by and between the District and Redgwick Construction Company, Oakland, CA, for the latter to order and install New Added Pieces to Plate Structure [in order to be age appropriate for ages 2-12], for the Sherman Elementary School Playmatting Installation Project, in the amount of $48,134.11 increasing the Agreement price from $203,900.00 to $252,034.11 and extending the term, by 197 days, from September 16, 2020 through November 15, 2020 to May 31, 2021.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds $48,134.11 to Redgwick's Sherman Elementary playground matting contract
summary: This change order adds $48,134.11 for new pieces added to a play structure so it suits ages 2 to 12 at Sherman Elementary School. It raises the contract from $203,900.00 to $252,034.11 and extends the term by 197 days to May 31, 2021. The contract term began September 16, 2020, before this approval.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
